segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some in dry winter climates or going through menopause, consistently report strong, lasting hydration and a calmer, less irritated feel.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who also have dry or oily skin, report no irritation and calmer, less red skin; no reviewer with sensitive skin reports a negative reaction.
segments.combination: The reviewers with combination skin report the serum balances their skin without feeling heavy or greasy.
segments.oily: The reviewer who also describes her skin as oily says the serum helped it feel less red and irritated without adding grease.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s, including several describing perimenopausal or aging skin, report firmer skin and visibly softer fine lines with regular use.

concerns.aging: Nearly all reviewers who mention signs of aging report firmer skin and visibly softer fine lines within one to a few weeks of use, with several specifically praising it for perimenopausal or 40-plus skin.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers across skin types describe strong, lasting hydration without a greasy or heavy feel; no reviewer reports the serum leaving skin dry.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers, including ones with rosacea-prone or sensitive-oily skin, report reduced redness and irritation with use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers who describe their skin barrier as easily compromised, including from acids or acne treatments, report the serum sped up their skin's recovery and strengthened its barrier.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers report the serum did not clog pores or cause breakouts, with one noting her small bumps nearly disappeared.

This product was complimentary from dermalogica, but does not impact my opinions.

I was glad I got to try this product, gifted by Dermalogica. I have very dry winter skin and thin spots that become irritated easily. This serum feels very nourishing and protective. It's a creamy white serum, fairly thick but not heavy. The squalane in it sinks in quickly and makes skin feel very hydrated and protected. It doesn't feel greasy or heavy and works well with other products.

This is wonderfully hydrating and caring on my sensitive + oily skin, I feel it helps my daily skincare needs as well as addressing my overall winter skin concerns. It is a thinner serum that soaks into my skin quickly, that feel a little creamy even. If you use it with other serums, it plays well with watery serums and I like it before sticky serums or the texture isn't as comfy to me. In just 2 weeks my skin has been less red and irritated, and I don't need to moisturize as much because my skin feels less dehydrated! Gifted by Dermalogica for review
